messages:
Maya Patel: Quick Q — I'm getting a 403 when opening the EU model-health dashboard for inference-prod-eu in Grafana. Anyone have the shortlink or know who to ping for RBAC? Thx.

infra-bot: Access denied (403) for maya.patel@redwood.com when requesting /d/abcd1234/model-health-eu at 2048123456.

Samir Rao: The dash is here: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/model-health-eu?orgId=1 — it's org-restricted. You need to be in the grafana-readers group (platform-observability). I'll open a request with infra. @infra-team can you add maya.patel to grafana-readers? I can also generate a short, temporary view link if you need immediate access. :eyes:

Elena Kim: Also, where should she look for traces related to that dashboard? Loki query example would be handy.

Samir Rao: Loki example for tailing recent inference traces in eu-west:```{0}sum by (trace_id) (rate({job=\"inference\"} |~ \"infer.*\" |= \"inference-prod-eu\"[5m]))```Adjust the labels as needed; swap job label if your service uses a different scrape job.

ops-bot: Created ops ticket OPS-8923 to request grafana group update for maya.patel — status: pending approval.

Tariq Singh: FYI last night we saw p95 latency spikes for model redwood-medium in eu-west; might be worth widening the alert window to 10m before reducing noise. cc @eng-oncall

Maya Patel: Thanks — using the query now. Samir, still seeing 403 after ~5m. Any ETA on the group add? If it's going to take a bit, a temporary shortlink would be perfect. :sweat_smile:

Samir Rao: infra replied — they need the ops ticket to be approved, which should be quick. In the meantime here's a temporary view-only URL (expires in ~2h): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d-solo/abcd1234/model-health-eu?orgId=1&viewPanel=1&token=eyJrIjoiTmpQeXl...

Elena Kim: Loki link for explore with the query prefilled for inference-prod-eu: https://loki.redwood.ai/explore?orgId=1&left=%5B%22now-1h%22,%22now%22,%22{job=\"inference\"}%20|~%20\"infer.*\"%20|=%20\"inference-prod-eu\"%22%5D — replaced trace ids for privacy.

infra-bot: OPS-8923 updated: grafana-readers group membership change completed for maya.patel — ticket closed.

Maya Patel: Confirmed — I can open the full dash now. Thanks all. Samir — can you pin the dash to the prod-eu watchlist or add a shortcut in the eng-platform workspace? Would help oncall.

Samir Rao: Yep will pin to prod-eu-watchlist and add shortlink to the eng-platform channel pin list.

Tariq Singh: Thanks — also filed a tiny alert tweak PR to widen p95 window, will link in the ops ticket for context.
